items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:73:1
items.html: ZA has VAK of BON and VAK of MA: and they are reckoned as one Guf, like the MA and BON in the Guf of Aba, or the MA and BON in the Guf of Ima, where MA is the male side within it and BON is the Nukva side within it, joined to one another at an equal level. Indeed, there is a great difference between the MA and BON in the Guf of ZA and the MA and BON in the bodies of AVI. For the MA and BON in the Guf of Aba are joined to one another face to face, which is a complete union, and so too the MA and BON of Ima. But the MA and BON in the Guf of ZA stand back to back, and are not reckoned as a complete union, as above in the ARI’s words, page 663, item 64. And see there in the Inner Light.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:73:2
items.html: That in ZA there is HG, which is MA and BON, and so too in the Nukva: this does not contradict what the ARI wrote above (page 663, item 65), that ZA is entirely the discernment of MA and the Nukva is entirely the discernment of BON, as explained well there in the Inner Light; see there.
